endorsements.quote: While AI technology offers significant advantages, it should not replace the expertise of healthcare professionals but rather support and augment clinical judgment.

unlisted_practices: Echo labs should implement robust data security measures, including encrypting patient data, ensuring secure storage, and permitting access only to authorized personnel.
Echo labs should adhere strictly to privacy regulations such as GDPR and HIPAA when using AI.
Echo labs should provide training to echo lab professionals on AI implementation to optimize integration into routine clinical practice.
Echo labs, AI researchers, and industry stakeholders should collaborate to establish standardized protocols for implementing AI in echocardiography.
Health systems should continuously validate and refine AI systems in collaboration with human experts to ensure reliability and optimal integration into clinical practice.

screen.reason: The paper is a perspective/commentary discussing the importance, workflow integration, training, and standardized protocols for adopting AI in echocardiography labs.
